title: What Does Fashion Week Do to the Nervous System?
scope_note: No located study measured Fashion Week attendees as a single clinical or neurological population. Every mechanism is transferred cautiously from the stated context.

sources.title: Sleep deprivation: Impact on cognitive performance

sources.title: The Effect of Noise Exposure on Cognitive Performance and Brain Activity Patterns

sources.title: Environmental noise guidelines for the European Region
sources.institution: World Health Organization Regional Office for Europe

sources.title: The connection between stress, density, and speed in crowds
sources.transfer_limit: A controlled pedestrian setting cannot predict one person in a Fashion Week space.

sources.title: A mobile EEG study on the psychophysiological effects of walking and crowding in indoor and outdoor urban environments
sources.transfer_limit: Urban crowd-scene results are a plausible attention mechanism, not a Fashion Week signature.

sources.title: The Trier Social Stress Test: Principles and practice
